title: Vergrim Clan's Bling
description: Vergrim Clan's Bling — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Skeer'ikt the Chirper

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: collect 7 Bling's Rings and 14 Bling's Amulets from Vergrim Whiskers in Vegrim's Vexation

Quest Reward: 1,875 Gold and 1 Kings Coins

Return to: Skeer'ikt the Chirper

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 21 Pieces of Bling from Vergrim's Whisker Clan and Return to Skeer'ikt the Chirper in Vergrim's Vexation off of Level 1 in the Cavernous Cavern of Caves.

Offer:

The Vergrimses Whisker Clan are a bunch of shows offs and Sissirats is sick of thems always rubbing our noses in their wealthes. Sissirats wanted me to go and collect their Blings from their dead carcasses, but since I have decided to takes up residence in this cage thats I am locked up ins, I don't have times to do it withs my busy remodeling schedules. Tracks lightings doesn't puts itself ups by itself now does its?

Go and collects 21 pieces of Blings from Vergrimses Whiskers and returns to me, Skeer'ikt the Chirper, heres in the Cavernous Cavern of Caves when you haves them all and I will rewards you with candies.

Turn-in:

Do you haves the Blings? Oh yessss, you does! So pretty, me wants to eats them alls up, yum! They looks much betters than these candies. Here you takes these candies and I'll takes the Blings. Maybe I eats some and maybe I puts some ups in my new home. Want to get mores?!

Objectives:

  • Bling Rings ×7
  • Bling Amulets ×14

Level range: 15–30
